title: English Practice Quiz 0851
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.
